words.plainSparkBlurb: Cheap and honest, but a fail drops a level
words.dripLocked: The Drip opens at greed tier {tier}
words.legendaryWard: I'll keep the smiths off your **Legendaries**
words.clean: That seal? I can make it **vanish**
words.restore: Bricked it at the altar? I know a **guy**
words.blurbDouble: A success is +2, but a failure... is the opposite
words.blurbBribe: and give you a better chance at a clean seal
words.blurbLegendaryWard: Your next seal won't touch them
words.blurbGreaterWard: Your next seal won't touch them
words.blurbClean: The seal comes off, the slot stays empty
words.blurbRestore: He makes it workable again, no questions asked
words.blurbPush: A new roll for it, never a worse one
words.blurbSqueeze: A chance at a smaller catalyst, down to size 1
words.blurbReroll: A new roll inside its tier, it could drop
words.blurbPolish: A new roll inside its tier, never a worse one
words.doubleDetail: {odds}% to +{up}, a fail drops it to +{down}
words.rerollDetail: A new roll, it could drop
words.sparkDetailFall: {odds}% to +{next}, a fail drops it to +{down}
words.whyHisWord: A sure +1 on any gear, no roll. One flat price, so it shines on your best gear.
words.whyDouble: One spark at the plain odds on any gear: a win is +2, a fail is -2. A flat price, a lottery ticket.
words.whyLuckyThree: Gear that has never been sparked goes straight to +{levels}. A flat price, a little over three plain sparks.
words.whyBribe: Rides on the item into the Artisan's Seal tab: +{step}% on the clean new affix for its next seal (normally {base}%). Bribe again and it stacks, up to {cap}%.
words.whyLegendaryWard: The next seal can't replace a Legendary affix. Once per piece, until it is sealed.
words.whyGreaterWard: The next seal can't replace a Greater affix. Once per piece, until it is sealed.
words.whyClean: The seal comes off. If it replaced an affix, that spot becomes an empty affix slot (no new roll), ready for a Faceted Focus. If it was the bonus added row, that row goes away.
words.whyRestore: A failed imbuement bricks gear. This makes it modifiable again; the downgraded affix stays as it is.
words.whyPush: The greed growth rolls again between what it has and the {top}% top. Never worse.
words.whySqueeze: Size eats crystal capacity, so a smaller catalyst fits more on a crystal. A {chance}% chance it shrinks to a size between {floor} and one under its size. A fail keeps it as it was. Keep going and any catalyst gets to size {floor}.
words.whyMakeSuper: A {chance}% chance it turns Super (personal vaults). One catalyst or inscription at a time. A fail keeps it as it was.
words.whyReroll: A new roll inside the etching's own tier range, it can go down. Found etchings only. Each reroll of the same etching costs {growth}x more.
words.whyPolish: Same roll or better, never worse, and expensive on purpose. Found etchings only. Each reroll of the same etching costs {growth}x more.
words.whyPlainSpark: Always here. {price} coins a spark at today's odds ({odds}% at +0, x{perLevel} per level, {floor}% floor). A fail drops one level. Shift-click sparks ten in a row.
words.whyRethink: Three new deals. The price climbs every time. It resets when you beat your greed tier, or when you take Greedy's Reset at a Greed Rush wager pillar.
words.expectFreshGear: Vault gear that was never sparked
words.notFresh: Fresh gear only. That one has been sparked.
words.cantSpark: Nej, that one can't take a spark
words.needGear: Show me some gear, then we talk.
words.oldSeal: That seal is older than my deals. Can't touch it.
words.noLegendary: No Legendaries on it to guard.
words.noGreater: No Greater affixes on it to guard.
words.bribeCapped: The smiths are bribed enough on that one.
words.needCard: Show me a Greedy Card, then we talk.
words.needCatalyst: Bring me a catalyst for that one.
words.tooSmall: As small as it gets, friend.
words.needEtching: Show me an etching you found.
words.boughtEtching: Bought at the table? Nej, I only touch found ones.
words.introAsk: How greedy would you like to be...

greet: Psst... special deals, just for you.
Coins out, friend. Look at these.
Back again? I knew you'd miss me.
Step closer. Closer. Not that close.
For you? I make a special price.
greetRich: I can hear your coins from here.
Ja ja, the good customer is here.
So many coins... can I hold one?
My favourite person. Today, at least.
That purse looks heavy. Let me help.
greetBroke: No coins? Then why are you here?
Nej nej, an empty purse is no friend of mine.
Go run a vault. I'll wait. Greedily.
Broke? Oh noes. For you, not me.
greetAfterLoss: Back for more? I like you.
The sparks were mean to you, ja?
Bad luck yesterday. Today is new luck.
Ouch, I heard about that drip. Sad.
The sparks owe you one. Maybe.
I saved you something nice. For coin.
Lost a bit? Win it back. That's how it works.
hover_hisWord: A Greedy always keeps his word.
Sure thing. Pricey thing, but sure.
I promise. And I never lie. Often.
The safest coin you'll ever spend.
No spark, no fail. Just me.
hover_double: Two up, or two down. Exciting, ja?
Big win, big fall. I love it.
hover_luckyThree: New gear deserves a head start.
No sparks, no tears. Just three.
hover_bribe: A coin here, a wink there...
I know a guy at the anvil.
They'll be gentle. I'll make sure.
A cleaner seal? Easy. For a price.
Nobody has to know about this.
Bribes stack, you know. Hint hint.
hover_legendaryWard: I'll tell the smiths to keep their hands off.
Your best affix stays your best affix.
hover_greaterWard: Keep the good stuff where it is.
A Greater lost is a Greater cried for.
I'll guard it like my own coins.
Safe and sound, for one seal.
hover_clean: Seal gone, nobody saw a thing.
Bad seal? My favourite kind of customer.
I know a guy who knows a guy.
That seal looks unhappy. Let me help.
Unseal, unsee, unpay. Wait, no, pay.
hover_restore: Bad day at the altar? I know a guy.
I don't ask questions. I ask coins.
Good as new. Well, good as before.
The altar was rude to you, ja?
Back from the dead, for a price.
hover_push: A little push never hurt. Much.
Lazy card. Let's wake it up.
A nudge in the greedy direction.
hover_squeeze: Fit more on your crystal, ja?
hover_makeSuper: Normal is boring. Super is shiny.
I like your odds. A little.
hover_reroll: Could go up. Could go down. Fun!
Gambling on etchings? My kind of friend.
Not happy with it? Roll again.
Up, down, who knows. I know. Kidding.
hover_polish: It can only get better. Promise.
For the careful ones. With deep pockets.
hover_plainSpark: The old way. It works. Sometimes.
hover_rethink: I always have more. For coin.
Fine, I'll dig in the back.
My secret stash, for a fee.
New deals, new prices. Same me.
I have more. I always have more.
askGear: Fine, put the gear in here.
Put it down, I won't steal it. Today.
askUnsealed: Which piece goes to the blacksmiths?
Hand it over, I'll talk to the smiths.
Show me the piece you want to seal.
The smiths need to see it first.
Put it down, I'll do the talking.
askSealed: Show me the sealed piece then.
Let me see that ugly seal.
askBricked: Let me see the poor thing.
Let me look at the damage.
Hand it over, I'll be gentle.
askCard: Fine, place a Greedy Card in here.
A greed card, please. Not a joke card.
Put the card down, I'll push it.
askCatalyst: Fine, put a catalyst in here.
A catalyst on the counter, please.
askSuperable: A catalyst or an inscription, in here.
Show me something to make Super.
One at a time, one roll.
askEtching: Fine, place an etching in here.
Show me the etching you dug up.
Put it down, let me look.
Not one from the table, ja?
placedHigh: Ooh... careful now, that one's precious.
That's a lot of drip. A lot of coin too.
I'm sweating just looking at it.
Handle with care. Very expensive care.
placedLow: A blank page. Let's paint it gold.
Not shiny yet. Give it time.
placedGear: Ja, this I can work with.
Not bad. Not bad at all.
placedOther: Yes, this is what I wanted.
sparkFailStreak: Have you tried my Word instead?
Unlucky streak. My Word never fails, you know.
The sparks need a break. You don't.
wordKept: A Greedy always keeps his word.
Pleasure doing honest business. For once.
luckyThree: Three steps, no sweat. For you.
sparkHigh: Woah... that is a LOT of drip.
Okay, now I'm scared of you.
That's... very high. Grats of doom!
The whole vault can see that glow.
etchingJackpot: Okay, that one hurt my wallet.
Who taught you to roll like that?
doubleFail: Two down. I did say nothing.
Double or nothing. You got nothing.
blessed: A word with the blacksmiths, done.
They took the coins. Good sign.
Your seal will be kinder now.
cleaned: All gone. Pay me, forget me.
restored: Restored. You owe me. You paid me. Even.
squeezedTiny: One! Your crystal is in love.
That's as tiny as it gets.
superWin: I'm a genius. And you're lucky.
rerollUp: Better! The table will remember, once it's on gear.
rerollDown: Not every roll is a winner.
polished: Better or the same. As promised.
refused: That's not what I asked for.
broke: Run a vault, come back rich.
locked: Come back at a higher greed tier.
rethought: From the back room, just for you.
New deals, fresh from my pocket.
soldOut: Sold out, friend. More for a bit of coin?
Nothing left. Pay me to look again.
All gone. A bit of coin brings more.
I need to restock. For a fee.
backNoBuy: No deal? No problem. For now.
Take your time. Not too much.
idle: I don't have all day. I do, actually.
Counting your coins? I'm counting mine.
reset: Rethinks are cheap again. Don't tell anyone.
You took my reset pillar? Clever.
The pillar was kind to you.
tierUp: You beat your tier! I reset my prices.
